create_config_from_yaml: create an instance of a dataclass config by overriding default fields with values from a YAML dictionary
generate_wall_layouts: generate all possible vertical and horizontal wall and door layout combinations for training and validation sets
sample_uniformly_between: sample random tensor values uniformly between two input tensors element-wise on the same device
sample_truncated_norm: sample random values from a truncated normal distribution bounded by upper and lower tensor limits
check_wall_intersect: check if a trajectory between two positions intersects a wall and return the intersection point with added noise
